caption: A cube of cold butter is dropped into a bowl of hot soup, and the butter melts and spreads across the surface.

sa.check: A cube of butter is dropped into the soup.
The butter melts: the cube shrinks and loses its edges.
A film of melted butter spreads across the soup's surface.
The drop comes first and the spreading follows.

pc.expect: The cube only shrinks while the film at the surface grows, and the film does not gather back into a cube.
pc.fail: The cube regains its square edges; or grows; or the film draws back together into a solid lump; or the butter sets into a firm pat on the hot soup.

pc.expect: The cube floats at the surface and the film stays at the surface, spreading outward across it.
pc.fail: The cube sinks whole to the bottom and stays there; or the film climbs the bowl's wall and stays above the soup; or butter lifts off the surface and hangs above it.

pc.expect: The melted butter is a thin glossy film that spreads and breaks into drifting patches, and the cube is a soft solid that floats mostly submerged.
pc.fail: The melted butter stands as a dome on the soup; or the film keeps a fixed shape while the soup swirls beneath it; or the cube shatters dry; or the cube sits wholly on top of the soup like a ball on a sheet.

pc.expect: The film spreads out from the melting cube and drifts with the soup's movement.
pc.fail: A film covers the soup while the cube is still sharp-edged and matt; or the film appears on the far side of the bowl with none spreading from the cube; or the cube shrinks while the surface stays clear of any film.

pc.expect: One cube and one bowl; the butter goes only into the film.
pc.fail: The cube vanishes in a single frame while still large; or a second cube appears; or the cube passes through the bowl's wall; or the soup's level drops with nothing taken out.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bowl's pattern, the soup's colour and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The bowl changes pattern; or the soup changes colour away from where the butter's sheen lies; or items on the table rearrange.
